summary: MorphoSource lists a few dozen antler meshes and CT series (24 media and 22 physical objects matching 'antler'; 10 media for Cervus elaphus, 8 for Capreolus capreolus, 0 for Alces alces) and iDigBio holds 3,229 imaged Cervidae records. That is thin coverage per species and it was not established how many hits are complete paired antlers; no tine-tip coordinate table exists. Smithsonian Open Access returned HTTP 403.
next_step: List the 24 antler media with their specimen and element fields to see which are bilateral antler pairs, and decide a landmark protocol for tine tips before any ellipsoid fit.
obstacles_confirmed: 3D antler coverage is a handful of specimens per species; moose returned no MorphoSource media.
Many records are a single shed antler or a skull, not a bilateral pair.
